title: Creator Hub
subtitle: Multi-shop creator management: overview, fulfillment, samples, videos, creators and commission, synced read-only from TikTok Shop Affiliate.
noShopNotice: No shops yet. Import a shop's cookies first, then sync its samples.

shops.title: Shops
shops.emptyDesc: Export the shop's login cookies with Cookie-Editor (JSON) and import them to sync that shop's samples, creators, videos and orders. One cookie export per shop.
shops.removeConfirm: Deleting "{name}" also deletes its login cookies, synced samples and entered costs. This cannot be undone.

cookie.subtitle: Import the shop's login cookies. The app checks which shop they belong to before saving.
cookie.step1: Install the Cookie-Editor extension in Chrome and sign in to this shop's Affiliate Center (affiliate.tiktok.com) in Chrome.
cookie.step2: On the Affiliate Center page open Cookie-Editor, click Export and choose JSON (copied to the clipboard).
cookie.step3: Paste it below, or choose the exported .json file.
cookie.step4: For several shops, sign in, export and add each shop separately.
cookie.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the name from the backend
cookie.jsonPlaceholder: Paste the JSON exported by Cookie-Editor, starting with [
cookie.security: Cookies work like a login: they are stored encrypted on this computer only, never uploaded or logged. Only import cookies for your own shops and never share them.

samples.search: Search creator, product or application ID
samples.readonlyHint: Read-only. Approve and ship samples in the backend.
samples.emptyDesc: Add a shop under Shops and click Sync data.
samples.editCost: Edit this sample's cost (empty uses the product default)

fulfillment.rule: Rule: a shipped sample is fulfilled once the creator posts a related video or LIVE. Deadline = application date + {buffer} days shipping + {window} days to post. Rate = fulfilled / (fulfilled + overdue); samples still in the window are not counted.
fulfillment.onlyDue: Only creators with samples past the deadline
fulfillment.missingCostHint: These samples' products have no cost yet and are left out of the total

costs.hint: Enter the cost and shipping of one sample per product (shop currency). It applies to every sample of that product; a single sample can be changed under Samples.
costs.pickShopDesc: Sample costs are entered per shop. Switch to a shop at the top right.

messages.loginExpired: "{name}" login expired, please import cookies again
messages.cookieMerged: "{name}" already exists, its cookies were updated
messages.syncedPartly: "{name}" synced, but these parts failed: {stages}. You can retry later.

errors.COOKIE_JSON_INVALID: Could not read the cookies. Paste the JSON exported by Cookie-Editor.
errors.COOKIE_EMPTY: No TikTok cookies found. Export them on the Affiliate Center page.
errors.COOKIE_NO_SESSION: The cookies contain no login. Make sure you were signed in to the Affiliate Center before exporting.
errors.COOKIE_SET_FAILED: Could not apply the cookies. Export them again and retry.
errors.COOKIE_SHOP_MISMATCH: These cookies belong to another shop ({detail}). Update that shop instead.
errors.LOGIN_EXPIRED: The login expired or the cookies are invalid. Sign in again in Chrome and export again. ({detail})
errors.SECURE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: System secure storage is unavailable, so cookies cannot be saved safely.
errors.SHOP_NOT_FOUND: Shop not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.SYNC_INTERRUPTED: The last sync was interrupted. Please sync again.
errors.COST_INVALID: Cost must be a number of 0 or more.
errors.API: The Affiliate backend returned an error ({detail}). Please try again later.
errors.SYNC_FAILED: Sync failed. Please try again later.

sync.rangeHint: Days pulled per sync. Creator stats and videos cover whole days up to the day before yesterday; orders use the order date. More days make syncing slower.

overview.noAnalytics: Creator and video data has not been synced yet. Sync a shop first.
overview.todoReviewHint: Approve them in the backend, or review them under Samples
overview.todoOverdueHint: Shipped and past the deadline without content
overview.todoAwaitingHint: Shipped, still within the posting window
overview.todoCostHint: Needed for complete sample cost and ROI
overview.funnelHint: With sales: fulfilled samples where the same creator sold the same product within the order sync range.

videos.search: Search title, creator, product or video ID
videos.emptyDesc: Choose a shop at the top and click Sync data: it pulls samples, creators, videos and orders.

crm.blockedHint: Excluded from approval suggestions and outreach
crm.scoreRule: Score 0-100: fulfillment 40% + GMV rank 30% + posting consistency 20% + refund control 10%. A ≥ 75, B ≥ 55, C ≥ 35, otherwise D. Creators with nothing due yet get 50% on fulfillment.
crm.notePlaceholder: Collaboration notes, contact preferences… (stored on this computer only)
crm.tagsPlaceholder: Comma separated, e.g. beauty, high converting, repeat

orders.search: Search order ID, creator or product
